import _codecs
for decode, data, expected in [(_codecs.ascii_decode, b'\xffZ', 'ordinal not in range(128)'), (_codecs.utf_8_decode, b'\xffZ', 'invalid start byte'), (_codecs.utf_7_decode, b'\xffZ', 'unexpected special character'), (_codecs.utf_16_le_decode, b'\x00\xdcZ\x00', 'illegal encoding'), (_codecs.utf_32_le_decode, b'\x00\xd8\x00\x00Z\x00\x00\x00', 'code point in surrogate code point range(0xd800, 0xe000)')]:
    seen = []
    def recover(error):
        assert error.object == data
        assert error.start == 0
        assert error.reason == expected
        seen.append(error)
        print('recovery', error.encoding)
        return ('?', error.end - len(data))
    _codecs.register_error('fault_record', recover)
    assert decode(data, 'fault_record') == ('?Z', len(data))
    assert len(seen) == 1
print('verified')
